capabilities: Edit raw YAML frontmatter directly in Live Preview with syntax highlighting
Collapse frontmatter into a compact summary row, optionally remembered per note
Style YAML in Source mode with bundled highlighting and a compact layout
Preserve and display inline or multiline Templater commands in frontmatter
Toggle frontmatter visibility from the command palette
extras: Spare-time project with no guaranteed fix schedule; developed in collaboration with OpenAI Codex (GPT-5/GPT-6). Works offline with no telemetry or network requests.
intentEvidence: It replaces the in-note Properties editor with an editable YAML block in Live Preview
problem: Obsidian's default properties editor hides raw YAML, so users who want the portability and full expressiveness of raw frontmatter lose a clean writing view.

relations.evidence: Frontmatter can contain inline or multiline Templater commands, including setup commands before its opening ---

summary: Replaces the in-note Properties editor with a syntax-highlighted, editable YAML frontmatter block that can collapse to a summary row.
